data.name: Judge Dredd: Dredd vs. Death
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Mega-City One, a city of over 400 million people - every one of them a potential criminal. It is the third decade of the 22nd Century, unemployment is widespread, boredom is universal and only the Judges can prevent total anarchy. Empowered to dispense instant justice, they are Judge, Jury and Executioner all in one. The most feared and respected of all the Judges is you, Judge Dredd.
Patrol the streets and mete out instant justice wherever it is needed. The Psi-Judges are predicting a terrible plague  is this the sudden outbreak of Vampires on the city, and are they the work of the malevolent Dark Judges?
  • JUDGE, JURY and EXECUTIONER it's your choice to shoot to kill, or disarm and arrest
  • Two-player co-operative LAN play throughout the entirety of the immersive storyline
  • Intense LAN action for up to 32 players
  • Customizable multiplayer games with enemy bots
  • Choose from over 60 characters for insane mayhem!

reviews.review: Honestly i really enjoyed this game, I just started reading the comics about a month ago and fell in love with the world of Judge Dredd so when i saw this game was available on steam i instantly bought it (since there's still no new game surprisingly) and i had fun the entire time playing. Only two issues, the jumping barley worked but luckily you only really need to jump 3 times, and escorting the NPC's was kind of a headache at times since they get stuck on everything. But besides that 8/10. I just really wish we can get a Modern Judge Dredd game, he deserves it for his 50th anniversary! I watched the gameplay of AtomFall and thought "This game engine would be perfect for Dredd" i know Rebellion is working on a new game called Alien Deathstorm and that looks pretty fun and i might buy it. Maybe after that we can finally get a new game? Please Rebellion it's all we want <3
